description: Analyzes an OpenTelemetry trace JSON payload (otelTraceJson, max 100,000 chars; span array or { spans, traceId } object) to summarize session token cost burn traps (default > $2.50), repeated-span sub-agent loop deadlocks, and per-span latency hotspots (default > 3000ms). Deterministic, stateless check requiring a Pro/Trial API key; returns rating CRITICAL on malformed JSON. Use for multi-span OTel/MCP trace logs; use systemores_measure_drag for single-turn character/latency math or systemores_audit_agent_graph for static topology analysis.

latencyThresholdMs.description: Per-span duration threshold in milliseconds above which a span is flagged as a latency hotspot (default 3000).

maxCostThresholdUsd.description: Maximum allowable cost in USD per session before triggering burn trap alert.

otelTraceJson.description: JSON string (max 100,000 chars) of OpenTelemetry spans — either a span array or an object with a 'spans' array and optional 'traceId'/'traceparent'.

name: systemores_analyze_trace_telemetry
title: Analyze OpenTelemetry Agent Trace Spans
